english.title: Concerned in the fraudulent evasion of a prohibition on the importation of a class A drug
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in relation to a class A drug, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CLASS 'A' DRUG AND INCLUDE THE QUANTITY..), was knowingly concerned in

(A)_[a fraudulent evasion of]_
(B)_[an attempt to fraudulently evade]_
(C)_[a fraudulent evasion of or an attempt to fraudulently evade]_

the prohibition on importation thereof imposed by section 3(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 170(2), (3) and (4) of and Schedule 1 to the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The prosecution must prove fraudulent conduct in the sense of dishonest conduct deliberately intended to evade the restriction, however there is no necessity to prove acts of deceit on a customs officer in his presence.
(ii) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(iii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine of £20,000 or of three times the value of the goods, whichever is the greater.
INDICTMENT: Life imprisonment and / or a fine.
